headline: E.ON to raise electricity prices from next year for half a million customers without a contract | ČeskéNoviny.cz
summary: Energy supplier E.ON will raise electricity prices from January for roughly half a million customers on contracts without a commitment. Fixed-price customers are not affected.
why: E.ON is a major European utility, and retail electricity price changes affect household bills and supplier margins in the Czech market.
